comment: Curated starter models (dev spec §8). Data file so the roster can change per release without code changes. Refs must be pullable by a stock Ollama install: registry tags or hf.co GGUF refs. downloadBytes is the Q4_K_M download size; minRamBytes is a conservative total-RAM guide (weights + KV cache + OS headroom). Roster researched Aug 2026: Mag Mell R1 is the community-favorite 12B (HammerAI's most-pulled model); Stheno v3.2 the perennial 8B entry pick; Impish LLAMA 4B the rare RP-specific small model; Cydonia the current 24B-class favorite.

models.name: Impish LLAMA
models.description: Small and quick, made for roleplay. Runs on almost anything — the pick for laptops without a big GPU.

models.name: Stheno v3.2
models.description: The classic starter roleplay model — dependable character voice, good pace on mid-range machines.

models.name: Mag Mell R1
models.description: The community favorite for immersive roleplay — rich prose and strong character consistency.

models.name: Cydonia
models.description: Big-machine pick: deeper, more nuanced writing if you have the memory for it.
